expect_red: one selection across the seam: the page posts the end row's verb once per node, reads the pane's answer, lets go when the pane lets go, and clears once

mutations.contract: A post is made once per node, not on every paint before the pane answers.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard (2026-11-12). Without the once-per-node gate a pointer sweeping the DAG re-posts on every paint -- the measured double activate.
mutations.find: if (!o.sweep || posted === nodeId) return result(null, false, posted, held);
mutations.replace: if (!o.sweep) return result(null, false, posted, held);

mutations.contract: A pane that let go of the row it held lets go of the page's selection, rather than being re-asserted.
mutations.note: Without the let-go branch the page keeps its selection and the pane's deselect is swallowed.
mutations.find: if (endRows.length && held === nodeId) return result(null, true, null, null);
mutations.replace: if (false) return result(null, true, null, null);

mutations.note: Without the CLEARED gate every paint posts `inspect clear` again.
mutations.find: if (posted === VA.SCENE_INSPECT_CLEARED) return result(null, false, posted, null);
